text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: This year's Yasuda Kinen has drawn an unprecedented crowd of over 150,000 spectators!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hello, thank you for coming today—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Members
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just by appearing in the paddock,
applause rang out in praise of Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Members
text_block_list.text:
Go, go, Lady Fuji!
Fight, fight, Lady Fuji! Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Too quiet!
Let's pump ourselves up and try that one more time~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...—Ahaha!
Everyone was looking forward to it so much, weren't they!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely show you a miracle today, too!
Please, don't look away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: She's just so cool after all~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Actually, when I posted an article about Fuji Kiseki, it hit 10,000 views~
so I just couldn't help coming to cheer today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! '#Fuji Kiseki Yasuda Kinen'
is trending at number 1~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: It looks like a huge crowd has turned out to witness a 'miracle'! Oh, I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~~?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama!
Hey there. Uh――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What's up with you?
You seem kinda different today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
Ah, maybe it's because I changed shampoo?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, I'll take your word for it.
Prying right before a showdown is bad manners anyway.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, either way, you'd better start focusing.
Once you're in the gates, nobody's gonna cut you any slack, no matter what condition you're in.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Yeah, I know.
...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With all eyes passionately fixed on Fuji Kiseki—
the Yasuda Kinen got underway...!
